sites.home_text:
yiliu.sh 
I'm Yiliu. I'm a designer and coder. I make software that helps people be better thinkers and makers. 
From 2018–2024, I went deep on spatial computing. That effort
 culminated in an AR productivity app called Spaceframe . Now I'm building Cube Computer , a cloud computer for running coding agents.
Previously: I was a research lead at Studio Olafur Eliasson ; an architecture student at the Harvard GSD ; an investment analyst at Morgan Stanley; and an econometrics
 major at Columbia.
I love making beautiful products that elevate their users.
 You'll find a log of my writing and work below.
